gaps.item: Real interactive Windows GUI smoke & acceptance
gaps.description: Manual human end-to-end interactive GUI testing in a running desktop Tauri window (clicking through canvas ratios, text inspectors, audio sliders, transitions, auto-captions dialog).
gaps.remediation: Requires a interactive user desktop session with GUI display; covered by huong_dan_test_phase26_tieng_viet.md.

gaps.item: Air-gapped Clean Windows VM without developer environment
gaps.description: Validation of the NSIS installer on a completely clean physical machine or VM without Node.js, Rust, Git, Visual Studio, or developer font caches.
gaps.remediation: Run TinixCut_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe on an isolated test VM and verify startup via app_health_check.

gaps.item: Direct GPU Hardware Encoder Qualification (NVENC / AMF / QSV)
gaps.description: Headless software encoding (libx264) is 100% qualified; direct hardware encoder runtime qualification remains deferred.
gaps.remediation: Exercise hardware encoder matrix on target GPU rigs and verify encoder fallback.

gaps.item: AC-09 Real GUI CapCut importer dialog observation
gaps.description: Manual interactive verification of the frontend CapCut importer modal, resource inspection list, and replacement workflows in the live Tauri WebView.
gaps.remediation: All backend conversion, ZIP extraction, and CommandService apply pipelines are 100% tested via automated integration tests (48 tests pass); live WebView interaction deferred to Phase 26 user session.

gaps.item: Embedded AI Provider Adapter & Native Staging UI
gaps.description: TinixCut provides headless CLI and MCP server tools for external agents (e.g. Claude, Gemini, GPT) to generate drafts. Direct in-app LLM API calling (embedded provider key management and native interactive staging UI) was deferred to keep core editor secure and model-agnostic.
gaps.remediation: External AI clients interact via MCP stdio or CLI commands; native in-app chat UI planned for post-v1.

gaps.item: ADR-005 & phase15_mcp_acceptance.rs tool count mismatch (8 vs 12)
gaps.description: Phase 35 added 4 new template tools, bringing total MCP tools to 12. phase15_mcp_acceptance.rs lines 247, 280, 1834 assert tools.len() == 8.
gaps.remediation: Product Owner / Boss to update ADR-005 text and phase15 assertions to reflect the expanded 12-tool MCP surface.
